source: CDC PLACES county releases (2025; 2024 where current estimates are unavailable)
vintage: 2025 release with 2024 fallback for 187 counties; measure years vary by indicator
notes: Model-based small-area estimates of crude prevalence among adults 18+, not direct measurements or individual diagnoses. The 2025 release has blank chronic-condition fields for some counties; 187 county profiles use the official 2024 release and carry a per-record vintage.
